description.p: KDE Connect allows you to connect to your devices and share files, messages, and more.
KDE Connect umožňuje připojit se k vašim zařízením a následně sdílet soubory, zprávy a další obsah.
KDE Connect umożliwia połączenie twoich urządzeń by dzielić pliki, wiadomości i więcej.

description.p: The is the new version with the following changes:

ul.li: Updated libcosmic and now follows system theme
Fixes Clipboard bug - Is now bidirectional
Added Mount/Unmount to Browse Files Plugin - Now mounts under ~/KDE Connect/<device> and auto-unmounts on disconnect
Memory Optimization - Fixes slow animations in drop menu
Please keep in mind, this is still a WIP - many things working but you might experience bugs.
Please report them under Github in issues section.
This new version still requires more testing before the release of v1.

description.p: The is the new version with the following changes:

ul.li: Improved SMS UI with added features (Hide Conversations, Unread indicators, Import contact photos, and able to send / receive media attachments)
Browse Files Plugin now implemented (Requires package sshfs)
Media controls with album art added to drop menu (Can still be controled from panel controls)
Please keep in mind, this is still a WIP - many things working but you might experience bugs.
Please report them under Github in issues section.
This new version still requires more testing before the release of v1.
